bill.title: Businesses: other; thermal impact assessment requirements for certain data centers; provide for.

posted_text:
🏢 MI HB 6252 — Michigan Could Require Data Centers to Study Heat Impacts

Michigan could soon require developers of large data centers to conduct thermal impact assessments before construction or expansion. The proposed law, dubbed the "Data Center Thermal Impact and Community Protection Act", would apply to data centers with a combined IT load of 25 megawatts or more, or those that increase their demand by 10% or more. ...
